HADESANCIENTS-ZEUS_ANCIENT.title: Zeus
HADESANCIENTS-ZEUS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.0-0r: Even the sacred bond of family can be broken, {:gendered:young man|young lady|young one}.
HADESANCIENTS-ZEUS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.1-0r: Remember there's no god of mercy on Olympus, {character}.
HADESANCIENTS-ZEUS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.2-0r: When all this is over, I'll make certain you're rewarded handsomely.
HADESANCIENTS-ZEUS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.3-0r: The time for amicable solutions to our predicament has long since past.
HADESANCIENTS-ZEUS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.4-0r: You keep your head held high, {:gendered:young man|young lady|young one}, for we're gods! The lot of us!
HADESANCIENTS-ZEUS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.5-0r: Together, we can rid this world of the Architect and his evil influence.
HADESANCIENTS-ZEUS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.6-0r: As gods, this world is ours by right. And we'll defend that right, won't we?
HADESANCIENTS-ZEUS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.7-0r: Our enemies will soon be in for quite the shock, I think!
HADESANCIENTS-ZEUS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.8-0r: We'll put an end to this little uprising sooner or later, hm?
HADESANCIENTS-ZEUS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.9-0r: Your dedication to this family doesn't go unnoticed, {:gendered:young man|young lady|young one}.
HADESANCIENTS-ZEUS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.10-0: Contending with upstarts and fools is just a part of godhood, I'm afraid.
HADESANCIENTS-ZEUS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.11-0: Olympus stands strong, and you'll help see to it we'll stay that way, won't you?
HADESANCIENTS-ZEUS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.12-0: We'll turn the tables yet, {character}! Go forth now with a token of my strength.
HADESANCIENTS-ZEUS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.13-0: You witches have a natural spark in you, I know, but here! I've got another.
HADESANCIENTS-ZEUS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.14-0: Do show our enemies a properly electrifying time for me, would you?
HADESANCIENTS-ZEUS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.15-0: The Architect can be outsmarted and outfought. We'll get him, {:gendered:Nephew|Niece|Kin}!
HADESANCIENTS-ZEUS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.16-0: Your father would be very proud, I'm sure. All of us are!
HADESANCIENTS-ZEUS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.17-0: We face a crafty adversary, yes; but we, too, have our ways, {character}...
HADESANCIENTS-ZEUS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.18-0: You'll help us tilt the balance in our favor, won't you, {:gendered:young man|young lady|young one}?
HADESANCIENTS-ZEUS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.19-0: I trust we'll have all this unpleasantness behind us in no time, hm?
HADESANCIENTS-ZEUS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.20-0: We'll soon have the Architect wishing he remained in deepest Tartarus, where he belongs!
HADESANCIENTS-ZEUS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.21-0: Become as lightning, {:gendered:Nephew|Niece|Kin}, and strike our enemies before they know what hit them!
HADESANCIENTS-ZEUS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.22-0: We didn't come to rule this world by underestimating enemies, my {:gendered:nephew|niece|kin}.
HADESANCIENTS-ZEUS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.23-0: I've pressing matters to attend to, so take care of things for me down there, would you?
HADESANCIENTS-ZEUS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.24-0: Always wonderful to see you, {character}! Even in times such as these...
HADESANCIENTS-ZEUS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.25-0: This storm of ours will rage on for as long as we see fit, won't it, my {:gendered:nephew|niece|kin}?
HADESANCIENTS-ZEUS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.26-0: Our family's had its downturns through the ages, though we always bounce back!
HADESANCIENTS-ZEUS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.27-0: That tingling sensation in the air, that's a sure sign that victory's at hand!
HADESANCIENTS-ZEUS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.28-0: I and the other members of the clan are behind you in your every step, {:gendered:young man|young lady|young one}.
HADESANCIENTS-ZEUS_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.29-0: All those who stand against Olympus shall be summarily struck down.
HADESANCIENTS-ZEUS_ANCIENT.talk.firstVis: Ah, {:gendered:young man|young lady|young one}, so we meet at last! Emerged from all that gloom to help us settle an old score. If you possess your father's strength, then we have the advantage! Let us strike.
